summary: This directory provides the testing suite for complexity analysis metrics. It validates the calculation, computation, and merging logic used to assess the computational or structural complexity of components within the system.
responsibilities: Verify the accuracy of complexity metric calculations
Validate the logic for computing effect-based complexity scores
Ensure correctness of merging operations for disparate complexity data
relationships: The test suite validates the calculation logic used to generate complexity metrics.
Effect complexity scores are verified against the standard metric computation models.
Merging logic is tested to ensure that combined complexity metrics remain accurate across components.
designDecisions: Collocation of test files with source logic under a dedicated evaluation namespace
Verification of algorithmic outputs for standardized complexity metrics
